style.backgroundSystem: two-field system held across the whole set: the fitting lives on a deep navy studio field #1E2A44 or a near-black blue studio field #0B1220, both with a soft radial falloff toward #05080F and no horizon; copy bands, masked windows and card grids live on a matte light page field #F2F2F2 with hairline #D8DADD dividers; masked windows are circles, pills and squares cut out of #FFFFFF
style.direction: industrial electroplated-hardware detail-page commerce, cold mirror-metal specular system
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight 2px line glyphs only, #3D6FB4 on light fields and #FFFFFF on dark fields; recurring frame furniture: 2px corner-bracket headline frames, dotted leader lines, square tick boxes, circular and pill-shaped crop windows
style.lightingSystem: hard directional key from the upper left at 10 o'clock plus one thin rim from frame right, deep falloff into the dark field, one continuous specular streak running along every faceted hexagonal body face, the tapered male pipe threads and the hex outlet nut casting micro-shadow, tight contact shadow grounding the part, neutral-cool 6500K, mirror electroplated metal never reads as plastic
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial electroplated-hardware e-commerce visual system across the entire detail-page set; fixed palette of deep navy studio field #1E2A44, near-black blue studio field #0B1220, matte light page field #F2F2F2, one accent steel-blue #3D6FB4, body text #2D2D2D and title text #FFFFFF; cool neutral tone, never warm; two-field background system with dark fields for the product and light fields for copy bands, masked windows and card grids; hard directional key from the upper left with one thin rim from frame right, deep falloff, one continuous specular streak along every faceted hexagonal body face, micro-shadow in the pipe threads and the hex outlet nut, tight contact shadow, neutral-cool 6500K; one modern geometric sans-serif family only, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; thin single-weight 2px line glyphs, 2px corner-bracket headline frames, dotted leader lines, circular and pill crop windows; identical part scale and mirror electroplated finish in every shot, fitting tilted 15-25 degrees off vertical on dark fields, faceted body, rounded inset indicator face, tapered male pipe threads and hex outlet nut always intact; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm lifestyle cast, no plastic-looking metal, no added logo or watermark or QR code, no invented numbers or credentials.
noDrift: no added logo, watermark or QR code
no invented sizes, thread specs, grades, torque, load figures or credentials
style.presentationRules: identical part scale and identical mirror electroplated finish in every shot; on dark fields the fitting is tilted 15-25 degrees off vertical so the 90-degree branch outlet axis reads toward the viewer; the faceted hexagonal body, the rounded front end with its single small round inset indicator, both tapered male pipe threads and the hex outlet nut stay intact and correctly placed; no hands, no people, no worn, scratched or corroded condition
style.surfaceSystem: glossy #0B1220 studio plate under the product on dark fields, matte #F2F2F2 paper page on light fields; never wood, never fabric, never warm concrete
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all Chinese and Latin characters; every rendered string is a short placeholder wrapped in 「」, headline 32-44pt, subline 16-20pt, label 10-14pt; titles in #FFFFFF on dark fields, in #0B1220 on light fields, body labels in #2D2D2D; no dense body copy and no keyboard-gibberish filler strings
